summary: Enhance your expertise in mergers and acquisitions with our comprehensive training course. Gain the skills needed to lead successful business transitions.
lede: Mergers and acquisitions integration leadership focuses on turning a deal into a coordinated operating transition. It is for integration, corporate development, HR, finance, operations and IT professionals who need to align teams after a deal, with practical methods for setting up governance and Day 1 plans, tracking synergies, and managing cultural integration and talent retention.
audienceIntro: This course is essential for professionals tasked with the strategic and operational success of organizational combinations.
modules: The M&A Lifecycle and Strategic Intent
IT, Data, and Digital Systems Integration
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of corporate finance and at least three years of experience in a management or project leadership role. Prior exposure to the M&A process is beneficial but not required.
